headline: Approved $450 accounting and $360 legal invoices, plus the August meeting minutes as amended.
summary: August year-to-date income was $107k and expenses were $22k, leaving a net of $85k. Income is $33k lower than the same point in 2025 because of market fluctuations, and legal expenses are about 14% ($3k) higher than last year. The authority also discussed its vendor annual renewal and assessment.
decisions: Approved the August meeting minutes as amended, all in favor.
Approved a $450 payment for McDonald's Q1’26 accounting service and a $360 payment to Boutin for December and January legal services, approved by all in attendance.

plain_text:
Londonderry Housing and Redevelopment Authority 
September 2026 Public Meeting Minutes 
DRAFT 
 
Date: Monday, September 14, 2026 
Time: 6:00 PM 
Location: Londonderry Town Hall, Elwood Room 
In Attendance: 
Commissioners: Dan Root (Chair), Dave Abbott (Secretary), Bill Me (Treasurer), Greg DePasse 
(Commissioner) & Chris Powers (Vice Chair). 
Guests: Jonathan Boutin (counsel) 
Called to order: by DanR at 6:04 PM 
The chair welcomed the commissioners. 
August Meeting minutes were reviewed.  BillM had a slight correction.  All agreed.  DanR motioned to 
approve the August minutes as amended.  Chris seconds, all were in favor. 
Old Business 
 Audits 
o Bob still providing Vachon info for 2024+2025 audits. 
Non-Public Session 
o In accordance with RSA 91-A:3 (II) (h)….. at 6:20pm GregD motions we enter non-public 
session.  BillM seconds.  All in favor. 
o In accordance with RSA 91-A:3 (II) (h)….. at 6:51 GregD motions we leave non-public session.  
DanR seconds.  All in favor. 
 Financial Report 
 August YTD  Income $107k, expense $22k, Net is $85k.  Vs YTD 2025, we are $33k lower Income due 
to market fluctuations.  Legal expenses are ~14% ($3k) higher than last year.   
 Invoices:  McDonald Q1’26 accounting service ($450).  Boutin $360 for Dec & Jan Legal services.  
Approved by all in attendance. 
New Business: 
 Discussion about LHRA vendor annual renewal/assessment.
•  Meeting Adjournment:  
DaveA motioned for adjournment and BillM seconds; All were in favor.  Meeting adjourned at 7:06P M 
Next meeting scheduled for October 5, 2026 at 6:00pm to be hosted in person at the Londonderry Town 
Hall.  
 
Minutes recorded by Dave Abbott, Secretary.
